what: When the text changes, the old letters switch off one at a time in random order every 60ms (.12s ease-out), and 100ms after all are off, the new letters switch on one at a time in random order every 60ms on the empty line — nothing moves, it is erased and stamped as if punching holes

options.step: Gap between characters (ms), default 60 — the original About section title uses 80
options.gap: Pause after everything is erased before the new text turns on (ms), default 100 — the original About section title is 150
options.dur: Duration for one character to switch off and on (s), default .12 — original About section is .15
options.in: If true, turns the current text on in random order as soon as it attaches (when first visible), off by default
options.fx:swap: Event sent to the element — swaps to the text in detail.text. When all are lit, the element emits fx:swapped

use:
First Section

… el.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("fx:swap", { detail: { text: "Second Section" } }))
